messages:
tay: noticed scheduler skipping nodes in ap-southeast1 after a rack flap, lots of tiny-gang pods pending
maria: which symptom? kube-events?
tay: here: 

Warning FailedScheduling  18m default-scheduler  0/96 nodes are available: 28 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 22 node(s) had insufficient resources, 46 node(s) didn't match node selectors.

tay: nodes recovered from NotReady but lost gpu_pack_group label and still have redwood/alloc-pin:NoSchedule taint
joel: lost label is interesting. kubelet restart path on the rack caused node-label-sync to skip the GPU topology write. seen that once when kube-proxy restarted mid-upgrade
sre-bot: recent events: rack-switch-apse1-02 flapped at 1728001500, kube-proxy pod on nodes restarted 1728001580
maria: quick check: 
kubectl get nodes -l '!gpu_pack_group' -o name | wc -l -> 26
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{@.metadata.name}:{@.metadata.taints}\n{end}' | grep alloc-pin || true -> 30 matches
tay: so ~20 nodes lost label and ~20 have alloc-pin taints. scheduler refuses to place because %gpu_pack_group mismatch and taint blocks
joel: short term: 1) relabel nodes that recovered and match NVSwitch topology 2) GC alloc-pin taints older than 10m if no matching pod 3) bump scheduler scoring to favor gpu_pack_group matches until binpacking stabilizes
maria: running relabel job now (dry-run then apply). command: kubectl label node node-apse1-{01..26} gpu_pack_group=pack-b-1 --overwrite --dry-run=client
maria: dry-run ok, applying -> 20 nodes relabeled
tay: triggering taint GC with safe checks now (only remove if redwood/alloc-heartbeat < now-10m and no pod uses alloc-id)
sre-bot: alloc-gc job run: removed alloc-pin from 18 nodes
joel: scheduler placements resumed, pending tiny-gang dropped 240 -> 68 in 5m\maria: follow-ups: add node-label-sync healthcheck to ensure gpu_pack_group is re-applied after kube-proxy/kubelet restarts; add a small reconciliation loop to relabel nodes missing topology within 2m of NotReady->Ready
tay: also propose scheduler tweak: prefer nodes with recent label heartbeat and penalize nodes with alloc-pin older than TTL instead of outright skip\maria: opened infra#2568 with dry-run logs and relabel plan\sre-bot: monitoring: created dashboard for gpu_pack_group missing by AZ and alert if >10 nodes without label for >5m\taylor: thanks team, closing thread once dashboards green :thumbsup:
